subject: Isolated-network ops: hardware compatibility, MOP proposal & next steps
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@genomex.bio>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & MOP outline for isolated-network deployment (Genomex)

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the detailed call today. Quick recap and a proposed next step list so we keep momentum: 

What we heard from you:
- Requirement: air-gapped/on-prem appliance behind an isolated network (no outbound internet except controlled egress to update buckets)
- Peak SLAs: 120 concurrent inference sessions, most requests <200 tokens, occasional long-batch jobs for analytics
- Lifecycle: quarterly patch windows, 6–12 month upgrade cadence preferred, strict change-control logs

Open items we promised to clarify:
1) Hardware compatibility matrix (GPU model, NVMe sizing, spare parts list) — Redwood to propose recommended BOM and minimum specs
2) Upgrade path for offline kernels & quantized model artifacts — how we package updates for air-gapped installs
3) Operational runbook (MOP) for patch windows and rollback steps — draft attached

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll attach a first-pass MOP and a small site-inventory template for your infra team to fill (requested today). Please share back by Aug 4.
- Ben will scope spare-parts recommendations and define a minimal replacement kit.
- If Genomex can confirm nominal GPU model (or tolerance range) we’ll map supported kernels.

Attachment: genomex_mop_v1.pdf (draft MOP), site-inventory-template.xlsx

Would you like a 30-min follow-up next week to walk the MOP and acceptance criteria with your ops lead?

Thanks —
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0118

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@genomex.bio>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & MOP outline for isolated-network deployment (Genomex)

Thanks, Priyom — this is helpful. Two quick clarifications from our side: 

- Hardware: we run two standard rack configs today (both on-site sets):
  * Config A: 2x A100 80GB, 2x 1.6TB NVMe, dual 10GbE uplinks
  * Config B: 4x A30 equivalent, 4TB NVMe, single 25GbE uplink

- Patch cadence: security patches quarterly; model updates during scheduled maintenance windows (we prefer non-disruptive hot-swap where possible).

I’ve looped in Samantha Lee (ops lead) to pick this up and fill the inventory template. She prefers a walkthrough before committing to timelines.

Yes, a 30-min follow-up next week would work — can you do Aug 2 at 10am PT?

On attachments: we saw the MOP draft and will review internally.

—Daniel
Head of Infrastructure | Genomex Bio

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: spare-parts + failure modes for Genomex configs

Internal note — drafting recommended spare-parts and quick-fail MOP bullets for Aug 2 call. Key points to validate:

1) For Config A (2x A100 80GB): recommended spare kit = 1x A100 spare board, 2x 1.6TB NVMe spare, 1x PSU spare, 1x NIC spare; reason: single-GPU failure modes can be hot-swapped with minimal downtime if NVMe is mirrored.

2) For Config B (4x A30 equiv): recommend full-node spare (replace entire server) + swap NVMe image restore flow; more cost-effective for scale-out clusters.

3) Offline upgrades: we will provide signed model artifact bundles and a checksum manifest. Customer manually ingests bundle into an air-gapped staging host; MOP includes validation steps (hash check, smoke test input set, performance sanity).

4) Rollback: keep last-known-good model artifacts on a separate encrypted USB or local object store; rollback MOP includes step-by-step iptables / routing freeze to ensure no egress while swap occurs.

I’ll attach a 1-page spare-parts BOM and a short failure-mode table to the meeting invite.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
